This week will see Apple's major iPhone launch event, which will also unveil new Apple Watch models. Below is a preview of the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12.

The Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 will feature a new chip, health features, and multiple upgrades

If you're interested in the new iPhone models being unveiled this week, there are already plenty of rumours summarising the expected specs for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra.

However, while the new Apple Watch models will appear alongside the new iPhones, coverage has been noticeably thinner.

Two new Watch models are expected to launch at the event:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • Apple Watch Series 12

Mark Gurman previously reported for Bloomberg that both models will receive a 'long-awaited chip and speed upgrade'.

The current Watch models use the S10 chip, but overall performance hasn't changed much since the S9 in 2023. With Siri AI coming to watchOS 27, a more powerful S11 chip could arrive at just the right time.

Digitimes claims the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will get a 'major redesign', but Gurman believes a significant design overhaul won't come until at least next year. He does note, however, that Apple will bring back the ceramic casing option this year.

The same Digitimes report states that the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will feature 'significant sensor upgrades', with up to twice as many sensors as the current Watch.

Some of the new sensors may be related to the rumoured upgrade to blood pressure notifications.

Apple first introduced blood pressure notifications in last year's watchOS 26. Reports say the FDA is reviewing a new blood pressure-related notification feature, which is expected to debut alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12.

Bloomberg also notes that Apple's new Watch models may feature a new always-on heart rate sensor.

New Apple Watch models: Summary

Overall, there's still plenty of room for Apple to surprise us with its new Watch models. A new chip, a smaller design refresh, and health features are all expected — but we'll have to wait until Wednesday for more details.

What features do you hope the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 will offer? Let us know in the comments.
